title: Execute admitted assignments through a new host and Scripted backend
goal: Run one bounded admitted assignment with attributable output, progress, usage and recovery observations, providing the execution foundation for all strategy roles and native adapters.
scope: Implement ExecutionBackend start/cancel/events/receipt and a real Scripted implementation, plus a host that passes only committed prompt/settings/grant/workspace/allowance. Keep Assignment, Invocation and native session identity distinct; record requested/sent/reported settings and actual bounded role output.

Handle ProgressSignal EvidenceAdded/CheckRun/ResultSubmitted/Heartbeat, ToolDenied, Output and Completed/Failed/Cancelled/TimedOut with Infrastructure/Environment/Protocol/Content/Unknown. Enforce timeout, native-turn, output and cost limits over the whole invocation, not separately per poll.

Persist start/observation/receipt/cessation basis and settle through Treasury. Validate never-started/cessation claims before independently releasing financial/path holds; disconnect, parent exit, elapsed time and cancellation request alone prove neither. Reattach/observe or remain truthfully blocked rather than duplicate unresolved execution.

Connect actual non-artifact completion to W1-0007 discharge; artifact production stays pending for W1-0008/0010 result submission/acceptance. Create deterministic Scripted outcome/usage/progress fixtures and a controllable clock. Role output is input to later policy parsers, never a kernel acceptance verdict.
context: Authority: model sections 3.4/3.7/3.9/4/5.7, A5/A13, P2 and R-2/R-8/R-9/R-12/R-19/R-20; greenfield baseline 0c61ff1.

Proposed modules: crates/ymp-kernel/src/execution.rs for trusted observation transitions and crates/ymp-runtime/src/{execution_host,clock,backends/scripted}.rs. W1-0006 owns admission/authority, W1-0007 commitments and W1-0016 durable state. This task builds all execution/supervision behavior from scratch.

Scripted controls model observations without native inference and may use task-owned local fixture processes/files for actual lifecycle checks. W1-0018 creates Codex; W3-0001 adds TeamOperation transport; this task does not invent mandatory EffectState/effects/control APIs beyond the model’s guarantees.

Legacy access granted (owner decision 2026-09-16, AGENTS.md rule): legacy-attempt-1:ymp-rust/crates/ymp-runtime-api/src/lib.rs may be opened for the termination ladder, honest termination recording and the failure-evidence record (commit ee96f70); legacy-attempt-1:ymp-rust/crates/ymp-runtime-supervisor/src/lib.rs for the timed-out-wait rule (commits b34ceb9, 6aa404b). Facts only; ymp-docs/legacy-lessons.md section 11.7.
acceptance: An actually admitted Scripted assignment runs, emits attributable bounded output/progress and settles one receipt, with non-artifact completion discharging its own commitment. A producer completion alone cannot accept/discharge an artifact result.

Start ambiguity, stream loss, cancellation, delayed receipts and restart do not duplicate calls, reset budget, revive grants or release unsafe scoped access. Validated cessation/non-execution releases only the corresponding holds, independently of unknown-cost settlement.

Scripted and a materially different backend contract implementation run through the real host; whole-invocation limits and response identity are enforced, unknown metadata/usage remain unknown, and malicious output cannot grant itself authority.
